name: biv_wall_ocs12_diseased
title: OCS12 diseased: BiV wall (approved)
description: Solid geometry, no mesh. Septal-aligned 3 mm build around the diseased OCS12 annulus (384 points, black ring): ann_rz 140.7 deg, LV endo 32 mm, wedge height 2.74 mm (45-degree rule). This is the approved wall the coupled runs use; it builds and meshes with all 384 annulus points imposed.
group: BiV walls from the OCS valves

name: biv_wall_ocs13
title: OCS13: BiV wall (solid only, does not mesh yet)
description: Solid geometry, no mesh. Septal-aligned 3 mm build around the OCS13 annulus (307 points, black ring): ann_rz 122.2 deg, LV endo 32 mm, wedge height raised to 4.34 mm (--wedge-below-annulus 1.0) because this annulus dips 3.3 mm below its mean plane; healthy-size RVOT placement. The solid is complete, but imprinting the annulus points along about 7 mm next to the septum-trunk corner breaks the tet mesh (2026-11-13).
group: BiV walls from the OCS valves

name: biv_wall_ocs14
title: OCS14: BiV wall (solid only, does not mesh yet)
description: Solid geometry, no mesh. Septal-aligned 3 mm build around the OCS14 annulus (261 points, black ring): ann_rz 132.8 deg, LV endo 32 mm, wedge height raised to 4.45 mm (--wedge-below-annulus 0.8), RVOT placement of the approved OCS12 wall. The solid is complete; the build fails later at the annulus imprint (2026-11-11). The variant with the healthy-size RVOT placement lost the pulmonary trunk and is not shown.
group: BiV walls from the OCS valves

name: clip_rv4mmHg
title: Diseased valve + clip in BiV, RV 4 mmHg
description: Run 01_clip_rv4mmHg: A1S2 clip, annulus tied to the 3 mm diseased wall, RV + trunk pressurized to 4 mmHg (t = 0.16–0.21 s).

name: septal_clip_rv4mmHg_midplane
title: Septal-aligned valve + clip in BiV, RV 4 mmHg
description: Run 03_septal_clip_rv4mmHg_midplane: valve rotated to ann_rz 140.7 deg (septal leaflet on the septum; clip_rv4mmHg uses 82 deg), A1S2 clip, annulus tied to the septal-aligned 3 mm diseased wall, roller plane at mid height, RV + trunk pressurized to 4 mmHg from t = 0.16 s. Run ends at t = 0.224 s.

name: clip_release_ocs14_damp1
title: OCS14 clip release, springs + damper (furthest run)
description: Run 44 w0.2_damp1 (standalone OCS14 valve + clip): pressurize, grasp, then from t 0.26 each clip body's zero-length spring to ground drops log-linearly from k 1e4 (factor 10 per 0.05 s) with a damper c 1 switched on. Clip drifts as one unit, no rotation: 0.13 mm at t 0.29, 1.0 mm at 0.33, 3.9 mm at 0.374. ERROR at t 0.377 (k about 46).

name: echo_tv_D-02-S-03-b_t0032
title: Baseline chordae (t0032)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-02-S-03-b reconstructed from echo. 49 chordae to 3 papillary points, ventricular pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s.

name: echo_tv_D-02-S-03-b_belly_col0PM4_clamped_p23
title: Belly chordae + PM4, clamped annulus, 23 mmHg (identification valve)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-02-S-03-b from echo. Pareto trial 32 (49 free-edge chordae, 3 papillary points) plus 24 belly chordae and a 4th papillary point under commissure col 0 (82 chordae), annulus rotation clamped, pressure ramped smoothly to 23 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s. The geometry used for the (G, t) identification; this solve is the pipeline's uniform neo-Hookean leaflet at the box centre, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.

name: echo_tv_D-03-S-02_t0043_fan5_L3
title: Fan chordae (5 branches, 3 mm), trial 43
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-03-S-02 from echo, Pareto trial 43 chordae rebuilt as fans: each of the 49 chordae is a trunk from the papillary point to a free branch node 3 mm off the leaflet (original stiffness 15 mN/mm and slack kept) plus five branches (15 mN/mm each, no slack) into a 5-node patch centred one row in from the original free-edge node; effective chord stiffness 12.5 mN/mm. Free-edge element stretch drops from 1.51 median / 3.37 max to 1.11 / 1.42 (leaflet body 1.30); closure unchanged (open area 2.4 mm2). Pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s, annulus pinned. Uniform neo-Hookean leaflet, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm. Rods = trunks and branches.

name: echo_tv_D-03-S-02_t0043
title: Rule-based chordae, Pareto trial 43 (closes)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-03-S-02 from echo. Rule-based free-edge chordae (49 chordae to 3 papillary points) from the 60-trial Pareto search, trial 43 on the feasible front (open area 2.3 mm2, contact 344 mm2 in the search). Pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s, annulus pinned. Uniform neo-Hookean leaflet, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.

name: echo_tv_D-07-S-01_t0046
title: Rule-based chordae, Pareto trial 46 (does not close)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-07-S-01 from echo. Rule-based free-edge chordae (47 chordae to 3 papillary points), trial 46 of a 60-trial Pareto search in which no trial met the closure constraint: smallest orifice (open area 88 mm2, contact 146 mm2 in the search), X-shaped regurgitant gap. Pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s, annulus pinned. Uniform neo-Hookean leaflet, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.

name: pm_ocs12_lowered_fixed
title: OCS12, PM tips lowered (fixed in space), RV 4 mmHg
description: Run 54: run 06's deck (OCS12 valve, uniform Posterior card, tied to the 3 mm septal-aligned diseased wall). The 7 papillary tips are moved by prescribed displacement over t 0-0.02 s to the lowered positions of run 51 r3 (4.4-21.1 mm) and then held fixed. Leaflet pressure 3.06 kPa by t 0.02 s, RV + trunk 4 mmHg over 0.05-0.08 s, ends t 0.1 s (last written frame t 0.098). Max leaflet height above the annulus at t 0.1 (P/A/S): 1.4/0.9/0.2 mm.
group: PMs on the RV endocardium (lowered tips, fixed in space)

name: pm_ocs13_patch_tie_r8
title: OCS13, PM tips tied to an 8 mm endocardium patch, RV 4 mmHg
description: Run 59 r8: run 23's deck (OCS13 valve, OCS12 Posterior card on all leaflets, tied to the OCS13 3 mm wall). Each of the 6 papillary tips is tied to every RV endocardium/trunk node within 8 mm of its wall point (22-29 nodes, cone weights 1-d/R), so the tip moves with a weighted average of the wall patch. Tips not lowered. Leaflet pressure 5.666 kPa by t 0.02 s, RV + trunk 4 mmHg over 0.05-0.08 s, ends t 0.1 s. Max leaflet height above the annulus at t 0.1 (P/A/S): 5.5/14.5/4.5 mm (one-triangle tie, run 47: 6.2/15.3/5.1; lowered fixed tips, run 55: -0.6/3.4/1.5).
group: PMs tied to the RV endocardium
